elevations.notes: Five horizontal glazing levels: glazed ground floor plus four upper ribbons; original narrow metal mullions and finely grooved offwhite spandrels.
Left courtyard wing, continuous horizontal glazing and offwhite spandrels.
Low glazed east pavilion with green metal framing and copper-green roof fascia.
Five continuous ribbon-window rows directly observed in upward panorama; offwhite small rectangular tile/grid spandrels, flat roof coping, ground-level black slat grille.
Separate recessed full-height glass zone: five glazed floors, dark opaque spandrels, blue-green original reflection gradient. Ground glazing has a black vertical slat grille.
South zone adjacent to glass inset is observed blank offwhite rectangular tile on upper three floors. No openings invented; lower unconfirmed area receives only the same original neutral material.

limitations: Observed public south courtyard and three separately matched eastern source wall zones are restored; outer north and west, roofs, low east street return and unobserved courtyard returns retain original municipal materials.
Narrow glazing subdivisions are authored approximations of the observed continuous ribbon construction, not a surveyed pane count.
Source geometry and all terraces and stairs remain unchanged.
dimensions: Source plane bounds are exact municipal geometry; opening positions, dimensions and colours are authored approximations fitted to observed architectural rhythm. No survey accuracy is claimed.
